svg.text: Shared bias/reference conditioning | external master references | SHARED_BIAS_MIM_V1
Three current-driven gate-bias ports; quiet voltage filters; a separately compensated dummy-return buffer. No ideal source inside.
Antiseries MOS nulling pair | compensation is part of this buffer
Four short process-poly units in series per quiet voltage; compact physical arrays follow.
Explicit process MIM banks | literal parallel units | grounded substrate shields
Reference current sources and master voltage sources belong in the testbench. VCAS in the replenisher remains AVDD.
Physical edge inventory | off MOS gates/sources/bodies tied to their rail; drains follow shared diffusion boundaries
Grounded MIM edge sites and compact resistor-array edge units are literal schematic components.
All modelled edge devices will be present in the one-cell layout; no analog subcells are introduced.
